name: Path to Ascension: Novice Rider is a riding trainer quest that rewards the race's starter mount
contract: Live CoA: the racial riding trainer offers 'Path to Ascension: Novice Rider' with the objective 'Learn how to ride and claim your first mount.' and the race's starter mount as its reward; the Path to Ascension book pays its own reward separately.

Quests 4420430-4420439 (Tutorial.dbc 110-119, Human 110 -> 4420430) are ordinary quests: Novice Riding (33379) gives their kill credit 445303 and the turn-in gives the race's starter mount (Human: item 5656, mount spell 458).
Tutorial 110 is verified once its quest is rewarded and the mount spell is known; its claim stays a separate reward.
Replaces the #6444 expectation that the quest is hidden: that held only while no trainer taught Novice Riding and the starter mount bridge was the tutorial's only mount source.
